summary.en: Step-by-step guide to log in using your registered phone number and password.
summary.om: Qajeelfama lakkoofsa bilbilaa fi jecha icciitiitiin itti seenan.
summary.am: በተመዘገበው ስልክ ቁጥር እና የይለፍ ቃል በመጠቀም የመግቢያ መመሪያ።

en: Click the gold 'Seeni / Login' button in the top navigation bar or go to /login.
Enter your registered phone number (e.g. 0911000001) in the 'Phone Number' field.
Enter your password in the 'Password' field. Click the eye icon to toggle visibility.
Click the royal blue 'Sign In' button to enter your Dashboard.
Tip: On the login page, you can use 'Quick Demo Login' to test different roles.
om: Bara sarara gubbaarratti furtuu 'Seeni / Login' cuqaasaa yookiin gara /login deemaa.
Bakka 'Lakkoofsa Bilbilaa' jedhu keessatti lakkoofsa bilbila keessanii (fakkeenyaaf 0911000001) galchaa.
Bakka 'Jecha Icciitii' jedhu keessatti jecha icciitii keessan galchaa. Fakkii ijaa cuqaasuun mul'isaa.
Gara Dashboard seenuuf furtuu cuquliisa 'Sign In' (Seenaa) cuqaasaa.
Gorsa: Fuula seensaa irratti gahee adda addaa yaaluuf 'Quick Demo Login' fayyadamuu dandeessu.
am: በላይኛው አሞሌ ላይ ያለውን ወርቃማ 'Seeni / Login' አዝራር ይጫኑ ወይም ወደ /login ይሂዱ።
በ'ስልክ ቁጥር' (Phone Number) ሳጥን ውስጥ የተመዘገቡበትን ስልክ ቁጥር ያስገቡ።
በ'የይለፍ ቃል' (Password) ሳጥን ውስጥ የይለፍ ቃልዎን ያስገቡ። ለማየት የዓይን ምልክቱን ይጫኑ።
ወደ ዳሽቦርድ ለመግባት ሰማያዊውን 'Sign In' (ግባ) አዝራር ይጫኑ።
ጠቃሚ ምክር: የተለያዩ ሚናዎችን ለመሞከር በገጹ ላይ ያለውን 'Quick Demo Login' መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

title.en: How to Register as a New Member
title.am: እንዴት አዲስ አባል ሆኖ መመዝገብ እንደሚቻል

summary.en: Register your membership in Waldaa Angafa Wareegamtoota Qulqulluu Giyoorgisii.
summary.om: Waldaa Qulqulluu Giyoorgisii keessatti miseensa ta'uun galmaa'aa.
summary.am: በቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ማኅበር ውስጥ አባል ሆነው የሚመዘገቡበት መመሪያ።

en: Click 'Miseensa Ta'i' on the Home page or go to /register.
Fill in your 'Full Name' (First Name and Father's Name).
Enter your 'Phone Number' which will serve as your unique login username.
Select your 'Origin Church / Branch' (e.g., Finfinnee, Adaamaa, Bishooftuu).
Provide your City, Kebele, and choose a secure Password (minimum 6 characters).
Select your Preferred Language (Afaan Oromoo, አማርኛ, or English).
Click the gold 'Register as Member' button to complete your registration.
om: Fuula duraa irratti 'Miseensa Ta'i' cuqaasaa yookiin gara /register deemaa.
Bakka 'Maqaa Guutuu' jedhutti maqaa keessanii fi maqaa abbaa keessanii galchaa.
Bakka 'Lakkoofsa Bilbilaa' jedhutti lakkoofsa bilbila seensaaf ta'u galchaa.
Damee / Waldaa itti tajaajiltan filadhaa (fakkeenyaaf Finfinnee, Adaamaa, Bishooftuu).
Magaalaa, Ganda fi jecha icciitii cimaa (yoo xiqqaate arfii 6) galchaa.
Afaan filattan filadhaa (Afaan Oromoo, አማርኛ, ykn English).
Galmee xumuruuf furtuu 'Register as Member' cuqaasaa.
am: በዋናው ገጽ ላይ 'Miseensa Ta'i' ይጫኑ ወይም ወደ /register ይሂዱ።
በ'ሙሉ ስም' ሳጥን ውስጥ የእርስዎን እና የአባትዎን ስም ያስገቡ።
ለመግቢያ የሚያገለግለውን 'ስልክ ቁጥር' ያስገቡ።
የመጡበትን 'ቤተክርስቲያን / ቅርንጫፍ' ይምረጡ (ለምሳሌ ፊንፊኔ፣ አዳማ፣ ቢሾፍቱ)።
ከተማ፣ ቀበሌ እና ቢያንስ 6 ሆሄያት ያለው አስተማማኝ 'የይለፍ ቃል' ያስገቡ።
የሚመርጡትን ቋንቋ ይምረጡ (Afaan Oromoo, አማርኛ, ወይም English)።
ምዝገባውን ለማጠናቀቅ ወርቃማውን 'Register as Member' አዝራር ይጫኑ።

summary.en: Switch seamlessly between Afaan Oromoo, Amharic, and English.
summary.om: Afaan Oromoo, አማርኛ fi English gidduutti salphaatti jijjiirradhaa.
summary.am: በኦሮምኛ፣ አማርኛ እና እንግሊዝኛ መካከል በቀላሉ ይቀያይሩ።

en: Locate the language pills with the globe icon in the top header or mobile menu.
Click 'Afaan Oromoo' for Oromo, 'አማርኛ' for Amharic, or 'EN' for English.
The interface updates instantly across the entire application without reloading.
Your language preference is saved to your profile and browser storage automatically.
om: Bara sarara gubbaa irratti asxaa addunyaa (globe) biratti filannoo afaanii argadhaa.
'Afaan Oromoo', 'አማርኛ', yookiin 'EN' irratti cuqaasaa.
Guutummaan appilikeeshinii yerooma sanatti gara afaan filataniitti jijjiirama.
Filannoon afaan keessanii ofumaan braawzarii fi profile keessan irratti ol-kaa'ama.
am: በላይኛው ራስጌ ላይ ከዓለም ምልክቱ (globe) አጠገብ የቋንቋ መምረጫውን ያግኙ።
ለኦሮምኛ 'Afaan Oromoo'፣ ለአማርኛ 'አማርኛ'፣ ለእንግሊዝኛ 'EN' የሚለውን ይጫኑ።
መላው ገጽ ገጹን እንደገና መጫን ሳያስፈልግ ወዲያውኑ ይቀየራል።
የመረጡት ቋንቋ በመገለጫዎ እና በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ በራስ-ሰር ይቀመጣል።

summary.en: Update your account password or request a reset from HR if forgotten.
summary.om: Jecha icciitii keessan jijjiiraa yookiin yoo irraanfattan HR gaafadhaa.
summary.am: የይለፍ ቃልዎን ይቀይሩ ወይም ከረሱ ከሰው ኃይል (HR) አዲስ ይጠይቁ።

en: Log in and navigate to 'My Profile & Security' (/dashboard/profile).
Switch to the 'Nageenya & Password (Security)' tab.
Enter your current password in the 'Jecha Icciitii Ammaa' field.
Enter your new password (minimum 6 characters) and confirm it.
Click 'Jecha Icciitii Jijjiiri' to save your new password.
If you forgot your password, contact your branch HR officer who can generate a secure temporary reset password.
om: Seenaatii gara 'Profile & Nageenya' (/dashboard/profile) deemaa.
Kutaa 'Nageenya & Password' jedhu filadhaa.
Bakka 'Jecha Icciitii Ammaa' jedhutti isa duraanii galchaa.
Bakka 'Jecha Icciitii Haaraa' jedhutti isa haaraa galchuun irra-deebi'aa mirkaneessaa.
Furtuu 'Jecha Icciitii Jijjiiri' jedhu cuqaasuun ol-kaa'aa.
Yoo irraanfattan hojjetaa HR waldichaa qunnamaatii jecha icciitii yeroo isinif haa haaromsan.
am: ከገቡ በኋላ ወደ 'መገለጫ እና ደህንነት' (/dashboard/profile) ይሂዱ።
ወደ 'ደህንነት እና የይለፍ ቃል' (Security) ክፍል ይግቡ።
በ'የአሁኑ የይለፍ ቃል' ሳጥን ውስጥ የነበረውን የይለፍ ቃል ያስገቡ።
አዲሱን የይለፍ ቃል አስገብተው በድጋሚ በማስገባት ያረጋግጡ።
'የይለፍ ቃል ቀይር' የሚለውን አዝራር ተጭነው ያስቀምጡ።
የይለፍ ቃልዎን ከረሱ፣ የቅርንጫፉን የሰው ኃይል (HR) በማነጋገር ጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ማግኘት ይችላሉ።

summary.en: Update personal information, city, church, and upload a profile picture.
summary.om: Odeeffannoo dhuunfaa, teessoo, waldaa fi suuraa eenyummaa haaromsaa.
summary.am: የግል መረጃን፣ አድራሻን፣ ቤተክርስቲያንን እና የመገለጫ ፎቶን ያድሱ።

en: Go to 'My Profile & Security' from the user menu or sidebar (/dashboard/profile).
In the 'Eenyummaa Koo (Profile)' tab, click the camera icon to upload a JPG/PNG profile picture.
Update your Full Name, Origin Church, City, and Kebele as needed.
To update your login phone number, enter the new number and your password in the phone section.
Click 'Haaromsaa (Save Changes)' to update your details.
om: Menyuu gubbaa yookiin saayidbaarirraa gara 'Profile & Nageenya' deemaa.
Kutaa 'Eenyummaa Koo' keessatti suuraa fe'uuf asxaa kaameeraa cuqaasaa.
Maqaa guutuu, waldaa irraa dhuftan, magaalaa fi ganda keessan sirreessaa.
Lakkoofsa bilbilaa jijjiiruuf lakkoofsa haaraa fi jecha icciitii galchaa.
Xumuruuf furtuu 'Haaromsaa' jedhu cuqaasaa.
am: ከላይኛው ሜኑ ወይም ከጎን አሞሌ ወደ 'መገለጫ እና ደህንነት' ይሂዱ።
በ'የእኔ መገለጫ' ክፍል ውስጥ ፎቶ ለመስቀል የካሜራ ምልክቱን ይጫኑ።
ሙሉ ስምዎን፣ የመጡበትን ቤተክርስቲያን፣ ከተማ እና ቀበሌዎን ያስተካክሉ።
ስልክ ቁጥር ለመቀየር አዲሱን ቁጥር እና የይለፍ ቃልዎን ያስገቡ።
ለማጠናቀቅ 'Haaromsaa' (አስቀምጥ) የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።

summary.en: Receive instant alerts about approvals, announcements, and programs.
summary.om: Waa'ee mirkaneessa kaffaltii, beeksisootaa fi sagantaalee yerooma sanatti beekaa.
summary.am: ስለ ክፍያ ማረጋገጫ፣ አዳዲስ ማስታወቂያዎች እና መርሐ-ግብሮች ፈጣን መረጃ ያግኙ።

en: Look for the gold bell icon in the top header on any page.
A red badge indicates the number of unread alerts.
Click the bell to open the notifications dropdown.
Click any notification to open its details or mark it as read.
Click 'Hunda Akka Dubbifametti Galmeessi' to mark all notifications as read.
om: Bara sarara gubbaa irratti asxaa bilbila warqee argadhaa.
Mallattoon diimaan lakkoofsa beeksisoota hin dubbifamne agarsiisa.
Bilbila sana cuqaasuun tarree beeksisootaa banaa.
Beeksisa barbaaddan cuqaasuun guutuu isaa dubbisaa.
Hunda yeroo tokkotti xumuruuf 'Hunda Akka Dubbifametti Galmeessi' cuqaasaa.
am: በላይኛው አሞሌ ላይ ያለውን የወርቅ ደውል ምልክት ይመልከቱ።
ቀይ ቁጥር ያልተነበቡ ማስታወቂያዎችን ብዛት ያሳያል።
ዝርዝሩን ለማየት ደውሉን ይጫኑ።
ዝርዝሩን ለማየት ማንኛውንም ማስታወቂያ ይጫኑ።
ሁሉንም በአንድ ጊዜ ለማንበብ 'Hunda Akka Dubbifametti Galmeessi' የሚለውን ይጫኑ።

summary.en: Communicate directly with leaders, collectors, and fellow members.
summary.om: Hoggantoota, funaantotaa fi miseensota waldichaa waliin kallattiin ergaa waljijjiiraa.
summary.am: ከአመራሮች፣ ከገንዘብ ሰብሳቢዎች እና ከሌሎች አባላት ጋር በቀጥታ ይወያዩ።

en: In your dashboard sidebar, click 'Wiirtuu Ergaa' (/dashboard/messages).
Select an existing conversation from the left channel list or click 'Ergaa Haaraa' to start a new chat.
Type your message into the text box at the bottom.
Press Enter or click the blue paper-plane 'Ergi' button to send.
Incoming messages appear in real time via live WebSockets.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Wiirtuu Ergaa' (/dashboard/messages) deemaa.
Bitaarraa haasawa duraanii filadhaa yookiin 'Ergaa Haaraa' cuqaasaa.
Ergaa keessan saanduqa gadii keessatti barreessaa.
Erguuf Enter cuqaasaa yookiin furtuu 'Ergi' jedhu dhiibaa.
Ergaan haaraan akkuma dhufeen battalatti skiriinii irratti mul'ata.
am: ከጎን አሞሌው ወደ 'መልዕክቶች' (/dashboard/messages) ይሂዱ።
ከግራ በኩል የነበረውን ውይይት ይምረጡ ወይም አዲስ ለመጀመር 'Ergaa Haaraa' ይጫኑ።
መልእክትዎን ከታች ባለው ሳጥን ውስጥ ይጻፉ።
ለመላክ Enter ይጫኑ ወይም 'Ergi' (ላክ) የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።
አዳዲስ መልዕክቶች ወዲያውኑ በገጹ ላይ ይታያሉ።

summary.en: Watch and listen to uplifting spiritual songs, choir worship, and sermons on YouTube.
summary.om: Faarfannaa qulqulluu, faarsaa koorii fi lallaba wangeelaa YouTube irratti daawwadhaa.
summary.am: መንፈሳዊ መዝሙራትን፣ የኅብረት ዝማሬዎችን እና ስብከቶችን በዩቲዩብ ይመልከቱ እና ያዳምጡ።

en: From the dashboard sidebar, click 'Faarfannaa & Media' (/dashboard?tab=media).
Filter songs by category: All, Gospel, Choir, or Sermon.
Use the search bar to locate tracks by singer, choir, or song title.
Click any song card to stream the YouTube video using the embedded player.
Staff can add official YouTube video URLs and manage the library catalog.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Faarfannaa & Media' (/dashboard?tab=media) deemaa.
Faarfannaawwan gosaan calaa: Hundumaa, Wangeela, Koorii, ykn Lallaba.
Mata-duree, weellisaa, ykn kooriidhaan barbaadaa.
Viidiyoo YouTube taphachiisuuf kaardii faarfannaa cuqaasaa.
Tajaajiltoonni liinkii YouTube haaraa galchuun faarfannaawwan dabalachuu danda'u.
am: ከጎን አሞሌው ወደ 'ዝማሬ & ሚዲያ' (/dashboard?tab=media) ይሂዱ።
ዝማሬዎችን በምድብ ይለዩ፡ ሁሉም፣ ወንጌል፣ መዘምራን፣ ወይም ስብከት።
በዘማሪው፣ በመዘምራኑ ወይም በርዕሱ ይፈልጉ።
የዩቲዩብ ቪዲዮውን ለማጫወት የዝማሬ ካርዱን ይጫኑ።
አስተዳዳሪዎች አዳዲስ የዩቲዩብ ሊንኮችን ወደ ማውጫው ማከል ይችላሉ።

title.am: የወንጌል ሬዲዮ (ቀጣይነት ያለው መንፈሳዊ የድምፅ ስርጭት)

summary.en: Listen to continuous synchronized YouTube gospel audio while browsing any page.
summary.om: Fuula kamiyyuu yommuu ilaaltan faarfannaa fi lallaba wangeelaa walitti-fufiinsaan dhaggeeffadhaa.
summary.am: በማንኛውም ገጽ ላይ ሳሉ ቀጣይነት ያለው መንፈሳዊ የሬዲዮ ስርጭት በኅብረት ያዳምጡ።

en: Look for the floating Gospel Radio player in the bottom-right corner of the website.
Click 'Tap to listen' if your browser requires autoplay permission.
The radio plays synchronized YouTube spiritual tracks across all connected listeners.
Adjust the volume or mute anytime using the mini-player controls.
Authorized staff can open the Radio Studio (/dashboard?tab=radio) to manage tracks and control broadcasts.
om: Gama mirgaa gadiitti asxaa Raadiyoo Wangeelaa argadhaa.
Yoo braawzariin hayyama gaafate 'Tap to listen' cuqaasaa.
Raadiyoon faarfannaawwan YouTube filataman walfaana amantoota hundaaf tamsaasa.
Sagalee guddisuu ykn xiqqeessuuf to'annaa mini-player fayyadamaa.
Tajaajiltoonni studio raadiyoo (/dashboard?tab=radio) seenuun sagantaa to'achuu danda'u.
am: በገጹ ታችኛው ቀኝ ጥግ ላይ ያለውን የወንጌል ሬዲዮ ማጫወቻ ያግኙ።
አሳሹ ፍቃድ ከጠየቀ 'Tap to listen' የሚለውን ይጫኑ።
ሬዲዮው ለሁሉም አድማጮች የተመሳሰሉ የዩቲዩብ መንፈሳዊ ዝማሬዎችን ያስተላልፋል።
ድምጹን ለመጨመር ወይም ለመቀነስ አነስተኛውን ማጫወቻ ይጠቀሙ።
አስተዳዳሪዎች ወደ ሬዲዮ ስቱዲዮ (/dashboard?tab=radio) በመግባት ስርጭቱን መምራት ይችላሉ።

title.en: Submit a Payment with Screenshot & View History
title.am: ክፍያን ከደረሰኝ ማስረጃ ጋር መላክ እና ታሪክን ማየት

summary.en: Pay monthly dues or donations via Telebirr/CBE and upload the payment slip screenshot.
summary.om: Buusii ji'aa ykn arjoomina Telebirr/CBE'n kaffalaatii suuraa nagahee ergaa.
summary.am: ወርሃዊ መዋጮን በቴሌብር/ሲቢኢ ይክፈሉ እና የደረሰኝ ስክሪንሾት ይላኩ።

en: Go to 'Kaffaltii Koo' (/dashboard/my-payments) in your dashboard.
Switch to the 'Kaffaltii Ergi (Submit Payment)' tab.
Select Contribution Type (Monthly, Tithe, Donation, or Special Offering).
Choose Payment Method: Telebirr, CBE Birr, Bank Transfer, or Cash.
Enter the exact Amount in ETB and your Transaction Reference number.
Click the upload area to attach your payment screenshot / transfer slip.
Click the gold 'Kaffaltii Ergi / Submit Payment' button to send for collector verification.
om: Dashboard keessatti gara 'Kaffaltii Koo' (/dashboard/my-payments) deemaa.
Kutaa 'Kaffaltii Ergi' jedhu filadhaa.
Gosa buusii filadhaa (Buusii Ji'aa, Asraatii, Arjoomina, ykn Gumaacha).
Mala kaffaltii filadhaa: Telebirr, CBE Birr, Dabarsa Baankii, ykn Callaadhaan.
Hamma qarshii (ETB) fi lakkoofsa ragaa kaffaltii (Txn Reference) galchaa.
Bakka suuraatti suuraa nagahee kaffaltii keessanii (screenshot) fe'aa.
Funaanaan akka mirkaneessuuf furtuu 'Kaffaltii Ergi' jedhu cuqaasaa.
am: በዳሽቦርድዎ ውስጥ ወደ 'የእኔ ክፍያዎች' (/dashboard/my-payments) ይሂዱ።
ወደ 'ክፍያ ላክ' (Kaffaltii Ergi) ክፍል ይግቡ።
የመዋጮውን ዓይነት ይምረጡ (ወርሃዊ፣ አሥራት፣ ስጦታ፣ ወይም ልዩ መዋጮ)።
የክፍያ ዘዴ ይምረጡ: ቴሌብር፣ ሲቢኢ ብር፣ የባንክ ዝውውር፣ ወይም በጥሬ ገንዘብ።
የተከፈለውን የብር መጠን እና የግብይት መለያ ቁጥር (Txn Reference) ያስገቡ።
የከፈሉበትን ደረሰኝ ስክሪንሾት (Screenshot) ይስቀሉ።
ገንዘብ ሰብሳቢው እንዲያረጋግጠው 'Kaffaltii Ergi' የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።

title.en: How to Print an Official Digital Receipt
title.am: ኦፊሴላዊ ዲጂታል ደረሰኝ እንዴት ማተም እንደሚቻል

summary.en: View and print official stamped receipts for verified contributions.
summary.om: Buusii mirkanaa'eef nagahee chaappaa waldichaa qabu ilaalaa fi maxxanfadhaa.
summary.am: ለተረጋገጡ ክፍያዎች የማኅበሩ ማኅተም ያለበትን ደረሰኝ ይመልከቱ እና ያትሙ።

en: In 'Kaffaltii Koo' (/dashboard/my-payments), locate any contribution marked with a green 'VERIFIED' status badge.
Click the printer icon or 'Nagahee / Print' button on that row.
A formal receipt modal will open displaying the church header, member name, amount, date, reference, and authentic church stamp.
Click the royal blue 'Nagahee Maxxansi (Print Receipt)' button to print or save as PDF.
The printed receipt contains the church stamp and unique verification code.
om: Kutaa 'Kaffaltii Koo' keessatti buusii mallattoon magaariisi 'VERIFIED' (Mirkanaa'e) qabu ilaalaa.
Tarree sanarraa asxaa pirintaraa ykn furtuu 'Nagahee / Print' cuqaasaa.
Nagaheen guutuun chaappaa waldaa, maqaa miseensaa, hamma qarshii fi guyyaa qabu ni bana.
Waraqaa irratti maxxansuuf ykn PDF gochuuf furtuu 'Nagahee Maxxansi' cuqaasaa.
Nagaheen sun chaappaa seera-qabeessa waldichaa fi lakkoofsa mirkaneessaa of keessaa qaba.
am: በ'የእኔ ክፍያዎች' ውስጥ አረንጓዴ 'VERIFIED' (የተረጋገጠ) የሚል ምልክት ያለውን ክፍያ ያግኙ።
በተከታዩ መስመር ላይ ያለውን የፕሪንተር ምልክት ወይም 'Nagahee / Print' ይጫኑ።
የማኅበሩ ማኅተም፣ የአባሉ ስም፣ የብር መጠን እና ቀን የያዘ ሕጋዊ ደረሰኝ ይከፈታል።
በወረቀት ለማተም ወይም ፒዲኤፍ ለማስቀመጥ 'Nagahee Maxxansi' የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።
የታተመው ደረሰኝ የማኅበሩን ማኅተም እና የማረጋገጫ ኮድ ይይዛል።

summary.en: Directly record cash, Telebirr, or bank payments received from members.
summary.om: Qarshii callaa, Telebirr ykn baankii miseensarraa funaaname kallattiin galmeessaa.
summary.am: ከአባላት በጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ በቴሌብር ወይም በባንክ የተሰበሰበውን ክፍያ በቀጥታ ይመዝግቡ።

en: Navigate to 'Galii & Buusii' (/dashboard/finance) from the dashboard sidebar.
Click the gold button '+ Buusii Haaraa Galmeessi'.
Search and select the member by name or phone number from the combobox.
Select the contribution type, amount in ETB, and payment method.
Optionally attach a bank slip or photo, and add any specific notes.
Click 'Galmeessi & Nagahee Qopheessi' to record the payment and automatically generate an official receipt.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Galii & Buusii' (/dashboard/finance) deemaa.
Furtuu warqee '+ Buusii Haaraa Galmeessi' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Maqaa ykn bilbila miseensichaa saanduqa keessatti barbaaduun filadhaa.
Gosa buusii, hamma qarshii fi mala kaffaltii filadhaa.
Yoo barbaachise nagahee baankii fe'aa, yaada dabalataas galchaa.
Xumuruuf 'Galmeessi & Nagahee Qopheessi' cuqaasuun nagahee qopheessaa.
am: ከጎን አሞሌ ወደ 'ፋይናንስ & መዋጮ' (/dashboard/finance) ይሂዱ።
'+ Buusii Haaraa Galmeessi' (አዲስ መዋጮ መዝግብ) የሚለውን ወርቃማ አዝራር ይጫኑ።
የአባሉን ስም ወይም ስልክ ቁጥር በመፈለግ ይምረጡ።
የመዋጮውን ዓይነት፣ የብር መጠን እና የክፍያ ዘዴውን ይምረጡ።
ካለ የባንክ ደረሰኝ ወይም ፎቶ ይስቀሉ፣ ማስታወሻም ይጻፉ።
ክፍያውን መዝግቦ ደረሰኝ ለማውጣት 'Galmeessi & Nagahee Qopheessi' የሚለውን ይጫኑ።

title.om: Kaffaltii Eeggatu Mirkaneessuu ykn Kufaa Gochuu
title.am: በመጠባበቅ ላይ ያሉ ክፍያዎችን ማረጋገጥ ወይም ውድቅ ማድረግ

summary.en: Review proof screenshots submitted by members and approve or reject them.
summary.om: Suuraa nagahee miseensonni ergan qorachuun mirkaneessaa ykn kufaa godhaa.
summary.am: አባላት የላኩትን የክፍያ ስክሪንሾት መርምረው ያረጋግጡ ወይም ውድቅ ያድርጉ።

en: In 'Galii & Buusii' (/dashboard/finance), click on the 'Kan Eeggatan (Pending)' tab.
The badge shows the count of pending member submissions awaiting review.
Click the eye icon on any row to open the full-size payment screenshot in a lightbox.
Verify that the amount and transaction reference match your bank statement.
Click the green 'Mirkaneessi (Approve)' button to verify the payment and notify the member.
If fraudulent or incorrect, click the red 'Kufaa Taasisi (Reject)' button, enter the explanation, and submit.
om: Kutaa 'Galii & Buusii' keessatti tab 'Kan Eeggatan (Pending)' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Lakkoofsi kaffaltiiwwan qorannoo eeggatan asirratti mul'ata.
Suuraa nagahee bal'inaan ilaaluuf asxaa ijaa cuqaasaa.
Hammi qarshii fi lakkoofsi nagahee sirrii ta'uu baankii waliin madaalaa.
Mirkaneessuuf furtuu magariisa 'Mirkaneessi' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Yoo dogoggora ta'e furtuu diimaa 'Kufaa Taasisi' cuqaasaa, sababa isaas barreessee ergaa.
am: በ'ፋይናንስ & መዋጮ' ገጽ ላይ 'የሚጠብቁ' (Kan Eeggatan) የሚለውን ትር ይጫኑ።
የማረጋገጫ የሚጠብቁ ክፍያዎች ብዛት በባጅ ላይ ይታያል።
የደረሰኙን ፎቶ በትልቁ ለማየት የዓይን ምልክቱን ይጫኑ።
የብር መጠኑ እና የግብይት ቁጥሩ ከባንክ ገቢው ጋር ትክክል መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
ትክክል ከሆነ አረንጓዴውን 'Mirkaneessi' (አረጋግጥ) አዝራር ይጫኑ።
ስህተት ከሆነ ቀዩን 'Kufaa Taasisi' (ውድቅ አድርግ) ተጭነው ምክንያቱን አስገብተው ይላኩ።

title.om: Galmee Miseensotaa fi Jecha Icciitii Haaromsuu (HR)
title.am: የአባላት ማህደር እና የይለፍ ቃል ማደስ (HR)

summary.en: Manage association members, assign service departments, and generate temporary passwords.
summary.om: Miseensota waldichaa bulchaa, kutaa tajaajilaatti ramadaa, jecha icciitii haaromsaa.
summary.am: የማኅበሩን አባላት ያስተዳድሩ፣ በአገልግሎት ዘርፍ ይመድቡ፣ ጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ያመንጩ።

en: In your dashboard sidebar, select 'Miseensota' (/dashboard/members).
Browse the directory or filter members by branch church and department.
To assign or transfer a member to a service department (e.g., Choir, Charity, Youth), click 'Kutaa Jijjiiri'.
Select the department from the dropdown and click 'Ol-kaa'i'.
If a member is locked out, click 'Jecha Icciitii Haaromsi' to create a secure temporary password and copy it to give to the member.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Miseensota' (/dashboard/members) deemaa.
Tarree miseensotaa keessatti waldaa fi kutaadhaan calalaa.
Miseensa kutaa tajaajilaatti (Faarfannaa, Arjoomina, Dargaggoota) ramaduuf 'Kutaa Jijjiiri' cuqaasaa.
Kutaa barbaaddan filadhaatii 'Ol-kaa'i' jedhaa.
Miseensi yoo seensa dhabe, 'Jecha Icciitii Haaromsi' cuqaasaatii jecha icciitii yeroo kenneefii waraabaa kennaaf.
am: ከጎን አሞሌው ወደ 'የማኅበሩ አባላት' (/dashboard/members) ይሂዱ።
የአባላቱን ዝርዝር ይመልከቱ ወይም በቤተክርስቲያን እና በአገልግሎት ዘርፍ ያጣሩ።
አባሉን ወደ ሌላ የአገልግሎት ዘርፍ (ዝማሬ፣ በጎ አድራጎት፣ ወጣቶች) ለመመደብ 'Kutaa Jijjiiri' ይጫኑ።
የአገልግሎት ክፍሉን መርጠው 'Ol-kaa'i' (አስቀምጥ) ይበሉ።
አባሉ መግባት ካልቻለ 'Jecha Icciitii Haaromsi' (የይለፍ ቃል አድስ) ተጭነው ጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ይስጡት።

summary.en: Generate and print official digital ID cards complete with QR codes and church seal.
summary.om: Waraqaa eenyummaa QR koodii fi chaappaa qabu miseensotaaf qopheessaa maxxansaa.
summary.am: የQR ኮድ እና የማኅበሩ ማኅተም ያለበትን የአባልነት መታወቂያ ካርድ ያዘጋጁ እና ያትሙ።

en: In the Member Directory (/dashboard/members), locate the member row.
Click the ID card icon or 'Waraqaa Eenyummaa' button.
A preview modal displays the dual-sided ID card with photo, unique Member ID, branch church, department, issue date, QR verification code, and official church seal.
Click 'Waraqaa Eenyummaa Maxxansi (Print ID Card)' to print directly on card stock or export to PDF.
om: Tarree miseensotaa keessatti tarree miseensichaa argadhaa.
Asxaa waraqaa eenyummaa ykn furtuu 'Waraqaa Eenyummaa' cuqaasaa.
Kaardichi fuula lamaanuu suuraa, lakk. miseensaa, waldaa, ganda, koodii QR fi chaappaa waliin mul'ata.
Kaardicha waraqaa jaboorratti maxxansuuf furtuu 'Waraqaa Eenyummaa Maxxansi' cuqaasaa.
am: በአባላት ማህደር ዝርዝር ውስጥ አባሉን ያግኙ።
የመታወቂያ ምልክቱን ወይም 'Waraqaa Eenyummaa' (መታወቂያ) የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።
የአባሉ ፎቶ፣ መለያ ቁጥር፣ ቤተክርስቲያን፣ የQR ኮድ እና ማኅተም ያለበት መታወቂያ በቅድመ እይታ ይከፈታል።
መታወቂያውን ለማተም 'Waraqaa Eenyummaa Maxxansi' የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።

summary.en: Record official meeting minutes, decisions, and administrative resolutions.
summary.om: Qaboo yaa'ii walga'ii, murteewwanii fi sanadoota bulchiinsaa galmeessaa.
summary.am: የስብሰባ ቃለ-ጉባኤዎችን፣ ውሳኔዎችን እና አስተዳደራዊ ሰነዶችን ይመዝግቡ።

en: From the dashboard sidebar, select 'Qaboo Yaa'ii' (/dashboard/records).
Click the '+ Sanada Haaraa Barreessi' button.
Select Document Type (Meeting Minutes, Official Letter, Report, or Resolution).
Enter the meeting date, number of attendees, title, and detailed content.
Add relevant tags for easy searching and archive classification.
Click 'Ol-kaa'i & Maxxansi' to record the document into the permanent archive.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Qaboo Yaa'ii' (/dashboard/records) deemaa.
Furtuu '+ Sanada Haaraa Barreessi' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Gosa sanadaa filadhaa (Qaboo Yaa'ii, Xalayaa, Gabaasa, Murtee).
Guyyaa walga'ii, baay'ina hirmaattotaa, mata-duree fi qabiyyee isaa guutuu barreessaa.
Barbaachaaf akka tolu taagii (tags) itti dabalaa.
Sanadicha galmeessuuf furtuu 'Ol-kaa'i & Maxxansi' cuqaasaa.
am: ከጎን አሞሌ ወደ 'የሰነድ ማህደር' (/dashboard/records) ይሂዱ።
'+ Sanada Haaraa Barreessi' (አዲስ ሰነድ ጻፍ) የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።
የሰነዱን ዓይነት ይምረጡ (ቃለ-ጉባኤ፣ ደብዳቤ፣ ሪፖርት ወይም ውሳኔ)።
የስብሰባውን ቀን፣ የተሳታፊዎችን ብዛት፣ ርዕስ እና ሙሉ ዝርዝሩን ይጻፉ።
በቀላሉ ለመፈለግ መለያ ቃላትን (Tags) ያስገቡ።
ሰነዱን ለማስቀመጥ 'Ol-kaa'i & Maxxansi' የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።

summary.en: Print official minutes with authentic church seal stamp and sign-off blocks.
summary.om: Qaboo yaa'ii chaappaa waldichaa fi iddoo mallattoo qabuun maxxansaa.
summary.am: ቃለ-ጉባኤዎችን ከማኅበሩ ይፋዊ ማኅተም እና የፊርማ ቦታ ጋር ያትሙ።

en: In 'Qaboo Yaa'ii' (/dashboard/records), click 'Ilaali (View)' on the desired document row.
A formal document view will render featuring the official letterhead of Waldaa Qulqulluu Giyoorgisii.
Scroll to inspect the authentic dynamic gold/red church seal stamped on the document.
Click the printer button 'Maxxansi / Print Document' to print the official document or save as PDF.
The printed sheet contains verified metadata, signatures section, and the church stamp.
om: Kutaa 'Qaboo Yaa'ii' keessatti sanada barbaaddan biratti 'Ilaali' cuqaasaa.
Fuulli sanadichaa asxaa fi mata-duree seera-qabeessa waldichaatiin mul'ata.
Gadi bu'uun chaappaa diimaa/warqee waldichaa sanada sanarra jiru mirkaneeffadhaa.
Waraqaa irratti maxxansuuf furtuu 'Maxxansi / Print Document' cuqaasaa.
Waraqaan maxxanfamu chaappaa, ragaa qorannoo fi bakka mallattoo qabaata.
am: በ'የሰነድ ማህደር' ውስጥ በሰነዱ ረድፍ ላይ 'Ilaali' (ተመልከት) የሚለውን ይጫኑ።
የማኅበሩ ይፋዊ አርማ እና ራስጌ ያለው የሰነድ ገጽ ይከፈታል።
በሰነዱ ግርጌ ላይ ያለውን የማኅበሩን ቀይ/ወርቅ ማኅተም ይመልከቱ።
ሰነዱን ለማተም 'Maxxansi / Print Document' የሚለውን አዝራር ይጫኑ።
የታተመው ሰነድ ማኅተሙን፣ የአረጋጋጭ መረጃዎችን እና የፊርማ ቦታዎችን ይይዛል።

summary.en: Publish announcements in 3 languages with optional Cloudinary images and pin options.
summary.om: Beeksisoota afaan 3'n suuraa Cloudinary fi pin waliin umuun maxxansaa.
summary.am: ማስታወቂያዎችን በ3 ቋንቋዎች፣ ከፎቶ እና ፒን (Pin) ማድረጊያ ጋር ያትሙ።

en: From the dashboard sidebar, select 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' (/dashboard/programs).
Stay on the 'Beeksisa (Announcements)' sub-tab.
Click the gold button '+ Beeksisa Haaraa'.
Fill in the Title and Description tabs: Afaan Oromoo (required), አማርኛ, and English.
Optionally upload an image (max 3MB) to Cloudinary and toggle 'Pin this announcement'.
Select publishing status: 'Publish now', 'Schedule for later', or 'Save as draft'.
Check 'Notify members' to trigger real-time notifications to all members, then click 'Ol-kaa'i'.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' (/dashboard/programs) deemaa.
Kutaa 'Beeksisa' jedhurra ta'aa.
Furtuu warqee '+ Beeksisa Haaraa' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Mata-duree fi ibsa afaanoota 3'n guutaa: Afaan Oromoo (dirqama), አማርኛ, English.
Yoo barbaaddan suuraa fe'aatii 'Pin this announcement' filadhaa.
Haala maxxansaa filadhaa: 'Amma Maxxansi', 'Yeroo Biraaf Qabi', ykn 'Wixinee (Draft)'.
Miseensota biraan gahuuf 'Notify members' filadhaatii 'Ol-kaa'i' cuqaasaa.
am: ከጎን አሞሌ ወደ 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' (/dashboard/programs) ይሂዱ።
በ'ማስታወቂያ' (Beeksisa) ንዑስ ክፍል ላይ ይሁኑ።
'+ Beeksisa Haaraa' (አዲስ ማስታወቂያ) የሚለውን ወርቃማ አዝራር ይጫኑ።
ርዕስ እና ዝርዝሩን በ3 ቋንቋዎች ይሙሉ: ኦሮምኛ (ግዴታ)፣ አማርኛ እና እንግሊዝኛ።
የሚፈልጉ ከሆነ ፎቶ ይስቀሉ እና 'Pin this announcement' የሚለውን ያብሩ።
የማተሚያ ሁኔታ ይምረጡ: 'አሁን አትም'፣ 'ለሌላ ጊዜ ቀጥር'፣ ወይም 'ረቂቅ (Draft)'።
ለአባላት መልዕክት ለመላክ 'Notify members' መርጠው 'Ol-kaa'i' (አስቀምጥ) ይጫኑ።

title.om: Sagantaalee fi Qophii Uumuu fi Bulchuu (Admin)

summary.en: Create ceremonies, feasts, and conferences with date pickers, locations, and images.
summary.om: Ayyaanota, sirnootaa fi walga'iiwwan guyyaa, bakka fi suuraa waliin qopheessaa.
summary.am: በዓላትን፣ ሥነ-ሥርዓቶችን እና ጉባኤዎችን ከቀን፣ ቦታ እና ፎቶ ጋር ያዘጋጁ።

en: In 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' (/dashboard/programs), switch to the 'Sagantaa (Events)' tab.
Click '+ Sagantaa Haaraa'.
Select the Event Type: Ceremony, Feast, Meeting, Training, Live, or Other.
Provide multilingual Title and Description (Afaan Oromoo required).
Set the Start Date/Time and optional End Date/Time.
Enter the physical location or church hall name and upload an event banner.
Click 'Ol-kaa'i' to save; upcoming events appear automatically on the public Home page.
om: Kutaa 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' keessatti tab 'Sagantaa' jedhu filadhaa.
Furtuu '+ Sagantaa Haaraa' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Gosa sagantaa filadhaa: Sirna, Ayyaana, Walga'ii, Leenjii, Kallattii, ykn Kan Biraa.
Mata-duree fi ibsa afaanoota 3'n galchaa (Afaan Oromoo dirqama).
Guyyaa fi sa'aatii sagantichi itti eegalu fi xumuramu filadhaa.
Bakka sagantichi itti geggeeffamu barreessaatii suuraa fe'aa.
Furtuu 'Ol-kaa'i' cuqaasaa; sagantaan kun fuula duraarratti battalatti mul'ata.
am: በ'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' ውስጥ 'መርሐ-ግብር' (Events) የሚለውን ይምረጡ።
'+ Sagantaa Haaraa' (አዲስ መርሐ-ግብር) የሚለውን ይጫኑ።
የመርሐ-ግብሩን ዓይነት ይምረጡ: ሥነ-ሥርዓት፣ በዓል፣ ስብሰባ፣ ሥልጠና፣ ቀጥታ፣ ወይም ሌላ።
ርዕስ እና ዝርዝሩን በቋንቋዎች ያስገቡ (ኦሮምኛ ግዴታ ነው)።
የመጀመሪያውን እና የማብቂያውን ቀን እና ሰዓት ይምረጡ።
ቦታውን ይጻፉ እና የማስታወቂያ ፎቶ ይስቀሉ።
'Ol-kaa'i' የሚለውን ይጫኑ፤ መርሐ-ግብሩ ወዲያውኑ በዋናው ገጽ ላይ ይታያል።

summary.en: Upload high-resolution promotional banners to Cloudinary that display on the public Hero slideshow.
summary.om: Suuraalee faajjii fuula duraa Cloudinary irratti fe'uun Hero slideshow irratti agarsiisaa.
summary.am: በዋናው ገጽ ላይ በሚንሸራተተው Hero ላይ የሚታዩ ውብ ባነሮችን በCloudinary ይስቀሉ።

en: Go to 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' (/dashboard/programs) and switch to the 'Banners' tab.
Click '+ Faajjii Haaraa (New Banner)'.
Enter the banner title and subtitle in Afaan Oromoo, Amharic, and English.
Click the Cloudinary file uploader to choose an image (folder wqg/banners, under 3MB).
Preview the image and verify high resolution and proper contrast.
Set the active status and click 'Ol-kaa'i'.
The banner instantly becomes the primary slide in the Home Animated Hero slideshow.
om: Gara 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' deemaatii tab 'Banners' jedhu filadhaa.
Furtuu '+ Faajjii Haaraa' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Mata-duree fi ibsa faajjichaa Afaan Oromoo, አማርኛ fi English'n galchaa.
Suuraa qulqullina qabu (folder wqg/banners, 3MB gadi) Cloudinary irratti fe'aa.
Suurichi sirriitti mul'achuu isaa dursee ilaalaa.
Furtuu 'Ol-kaa'i' cuqaasaa.
Faajjiin kun battalatti Hero Slideshow fuula duraa irratti dura ta'ee mul'ata.
am: ወደ 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' ይሂዱ እና 'ባነሮች' (Banners) የሚለውን ትር ይምረጡ።
'+ Faajjii Haaraa' (አዲስ ባነር) የሚለውን ይጫኑ።
የባነሩን ርዕስ እና ንዑስ ርዕስ በኦሮምኛ፣ አማርኛ እና እንግሊዝኛ ያስገቡ።
ጥራት ያለው ፎቶ በCloudinary ላይ ይስቀሉ (ከ3MB በታች)።
ፎቶው በትክክል መታየቱን በቅድመ እይታ ያረጋግጡ።
'Ol-kaa'i' (አስቀምጥ) የሚለውን ይጫኑ።
ባነሩ ወዲያውኑ በዋናው ገጽ ተንሸራታች Hero ላይ የመጀመሪያ ስላይድ ሆኖ ይታያል።

summary.en: Manage the 3 weekly schedule cards shown on Home and reorder rows with up/down controls.
summary.om: Kaardota sagantaa kadhannaa torbee fuula duraarra jiran gulaalaa fi tartiiba jijjiiraa.
summary.am: በዋና ገጽ ላይ ያሉትን 3 የሳምንት መርሐ-ግብሮች ያስተካክሉ እና ቅደም ተከተላቸውን ይቀይሩ።

en: In 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' (/dashboard/programs), switch to the 'Sagantaa Torbee (Weekly Schedule)' tab.
Select the ministry group: Sunday Service (Kadhannaa), Youth Ministry (Dargaggoota), or Online Fellowship (Tokkummaa Online).
To add a new row, click '+ Sagantaa Haaraa', enter When, Time, and What in 3 languages, and save.
To change order, click the Up or Down arrow buttons on any row to instantly update ordering on the public Home page.
To modify existing prayer times, click 'Gulaali (Edit)'.
om: Kutaa 'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' keessatti tab 'Sagantaa Torbee' jedhu filadhaa.
Garee tajaajilaa filadhaa: Sunday Service (Kadhannaa), Dargaggoota, ykn Tokkummaa Online.
Sagantaa haaraa dabaluuf '+ Sagantaa Haaraa' cuqaasaa, Yeroo, Sa'aatii fi Wanta raawwatamu galchaa.
Tartiiba jijjiiruuf asxaa xiyyaa ol/gadii cuqaasuun fuula duraa irratti tartiibessaa.
Sa'aatii sirreessuuf 'Gulaali' kan jedhu cuqaasaa.
am: በ'Sagantaalee & Beeksisa' ውስጥ 'የሳምንት መርሐ-ግብር' (Weekly Schedule) የሚለውን ይምረጡ።
የአገልግሎት ዘርፉን ይምረጡ: የዕሁድ አገልግሎት፣ የወጣቶች፣ ወይም የበይነመረብ ኅብረት።
አዲስ ለመጨመር '+ Sagantaa Haaraa' ይጫኑ፤ ጊዜውን፣ ሰዓቱን እና ተግባሩን አስገብተው ያስቀምጡ።
ቅደም ተከተል ለመቀየር የቀስት ምልክቶቹን ወደ ላይ ወይም ወደ ታች ይጫኑ።
ሰዓቶችን ለማስተካከል 'Gulaali' (አስተካክል) የሚለውን ይጫኑ።

title.am: የሠራተኞችን እና የአባላትን የሥራ ድርሻ ማስተዳደር (አድሚን)

summary.en: Assign and update roles (Collector, HR, Secretary, Admin) and view security audit logs.
summary.om: Gahee hojii (Walitti-qabaa, HR, Barreessaa, Admin) kennaa fi galmee nageenyaa ilaalaa.
summary.am: የሥራ ድርሻዎችን (ሰብሳቢ፣ HR፣ ፀሐፊ፣ አድሚን) ይመድቡ እና የደህንነት ኦዲት መዝገቦችን ይመልከቱ።

en: In your dashboard sidebar, select 'Qindaa'ina' (/dashboard/settings).
Review the System Overview stats, active user count, and storage metrics.
Under User Role Management, search for any member by name or phone.
Select the appropriate role: MEMBER, COLLECTOR, HR, SECRETARY, or ADMIN.
Click 'Gahee Jijjiiri (Update Role)' to grant or revoke administrative permissions.
Scroll down to 'Audit Logs' to inspect all sensitive system actions and timestamps.
om: Saayidbaarirraa gara 'Qindaa'ina' (/dashboard/settings) deemaa.
Ilaalcha waliigalaa sirnichaa fi baay'ina miseensotaa ilaalaa.
Kutaa 'User Role Management' keessatti maqaa miseensichaa barbaadaa.
Gahee hojii barbaaddan filadhaa: MEMBER, COLLECTOR, HR, SECRETARY, ykn ADMIN.
Furtuu 'Gahee Jijjiiri' cuqaasuun eeyyama hojichaa kennaaf.
Gadi bu'uun galmee gochawwan sirnichaa (Audit Logs) keessatti eeggumsa godhame qoradhaa.
am: ከጎን አሞሌው ወደ 'ማስተካከያ' (/dashboard/settings) ይሂዱ።
የአጠቃላይ ሥርዓቱን ሁኔታ እና የተጠቃሚዎችን ብዛት ይመልከቱ።
በተጠቃሚዎች ድርሻ ክፍል ውስጥ አባሉን በስም ወይም በስልክ ይፈልጉ።
ተገቢውን የሥራ ድርሻ ይምረጡ: MEMBER, COLLECTOR, HR, SECRETARY, ወይም ADMIN።
'Gahee Jijjiiri' (ድርሻ ቀይር) የሚለውን ተጭነው ፍቃዱን ይስጡ።
በገጹ ግርጌ ላይ ያለውን የኦዲት መዝገብ (Audit Logs) በመመልከት የተከናወኑ ተግባራትን ያረጋግጡ።

title.en: Troubleshooting: Gospel Radio Not Playing Audio
title.om: Furmaata: Raadiyoon Sagalee Yoo Dhageessisuu Baate

summary.en: How to resolve browser autoplay blocking or YouTube connectivity issues for Gospel Radio.
summary.om: Akkamitti rakkoo sagalee fi eeyyama braawzarii Raadiyoo Wangeelaaf furuu dandeessu.
summary.am: የአሳሽ አውቶፕሌይ እገዳን በማንሳት የወንጌል ሬዲዮ ድምጽን እንዴት ማስተካከል እንደሚቻል።

en: Click the gold 'Tap to listen' button on the mini-player in the bottom corner.
Ensure your device volume is turned up and not in silent or mute mode.
If playback is blocked, check your browser's site settings to allow Sound/Autoplay for this site.
Refresh the page (F5 or swipe down on mobile) to reconnect to the live radio stream.
om: Gama jalaatti furtuu 'Tap to listen' jedhu cuqaasaa.
Sagaleen meeshaa keessanii banamuu fi callisaarra hin jirre mirkaneeffadhaa.
Qindaa'ina braawzarii keessanii keessatti sagaleen akka dhaga'amu 'Allow' godhaa.
Fuulicha haaromsaa (F5 ykn gadi harkisaa) deebi'aa dhaggeeffadhaa.
am: በታችኛው ጥግ ላይ ያለውን 'Tap to listen' የሚለውን ቁልፍ ይጫኑ።
የስልክዎ ወይም የኮምፒውተርዎ ድምፅ ክፍት መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
በአሳሽዎ ቅንብሮች ውስጥ ለዚህ ድረ-ገጽ ድምፅ እንዲፈቀድ (Sound/Autoplay Allow) ያድርጉ።
ገጹን እንደገና ይጫኑት (Refresh) እና መልሰው ያዳምጡ።

summary.en: Tips to improve speed, clear browser cache, and handle low-bandwidth network connections.
summary.om: Saffisa dabaluuf, kaashii qulqulleessuu fi qunnamtii interneetaa laafaa dandamachuu.
summary.am: ፍጥነትን ለመጨመር፣ የአሳሽ ማህደረ-ትውስታን (Cache) ለማጽዳት እና ደካማ ኢንተርኔትን ለማስተካከል የሚረዱ ነጥቦች።

en: Check that your Wi-Fi or mobile data connection is stable.
Perform a hard refresh: Press Ctrl + Shift + R on Windows (or Cmd + Shift + R on Mac).
Clear browser cache: In Chrome settings, select 'Clear browsing data' -> 'Cached images and files'.
Close other streaming video tabs or background downloads.
The application is optimized with React code-splitting and asset compression to load fast even on 3G.
om: Interneetiin keessan (Wi-Fi ykn Daataa) sirriitti hojjechaa jiraachuu mirkaneeffadhaa.
Kompiitara irratti Ctrl + Shift + R cuqaasuun fuulicha haaromsaa.
Kaashii braawzarii qulqulleessaa: Qindaa'ina Chrome keessatti 'Clear browsing data' filadhaa.
Kutaalee yookiin viidiyoolee biraa duubaan banamanii jiran cufaa.
Sirnichi qusannoo dataatiin kan hojjetame waan ta'eef interneeta laafaa irrattiyyuu ni hojjeta.
am: የዋይፋይ ወይም የሞባይል ዳታ ግንኙነትዎ አስተማማኝ መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
ገጹን በሙሉ ለማደስ በቁልፍ ሰሌዳው ላይ Ctrl + Shift + R ን ይጫኑ።
የአሳሽ ማህደረ-ትውስታን (Cache) ያጽዱ: በክሮም ማስተካከያ ውስጥ 'Clear browsing data' ይምረጡ።
ከበስተጀርባ የተከፈቱ ሌሎች የቪዲዮ መስኮቶችን ይዝጉ።
ይህ ድረ-ገጽ በዝቅተኛ የኢንተርኔት ፍጥነትም ቢሆን በፍጥነት እንዲከፈት በሚገባ የተገነባ ነው።

title.en: Troubleshooting: Wrong Password or Account Locked
title.om: Furmaata: Jecha Icciitii Dogoggoraa ykn Cufamuu
title.am: መፍትሔ: የተሳሳተ የይለፍ ቃል ወይም መግባት ካልቻሉ

summary.en: What to do if your credentials fail or your account is restricted.
summary.om: Yoo jechi icciitii keessan didu yookiin akkaawuntiin cufame maal gochuu qabdu.
summary.am: የይለፍ ቃልዎ ካልሰራ ወይም መለያዎ ከታገደ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለብዎ።

en: Verify your phone number format (e.g. starting with 09... without country code prefix).
Click the eye icon in the password field to verify that caps lock is off and spelling is correct.
If you recently changed your password, ensure you are using the updated secret.
If your password was reset by an admin, log in using the temporary password provided.
Upon first login with a temporary password, the system will prompt you to choose a new private password.
If still unable to enter, call your local branch HR officer or secretary to verify your phone number and reset credentials.
om: Lakkoofsa bilbila keessanii sirrii ta'uu isaa (09... jalqabuun) ilaalaa.
Asxaa ijaa cuqaasuun arfiileen gurguddaa fi xixiqqaan sirrii ta'uu mirkaneeffadhaa.
Dhihootti yoo jijjiirtaniittu ta'e isa haaraa fayyadamaa.
Hojjetaan HR yoo isiniif haaromse jecha icciitii yeroo isiniif kenname galchaa.
Jecha icciitii yerootiin yommuu seentan battalatti isa haaraa akka uumtan isin gaafata.
Ammas yoo didu, hojjetaa HR waldichaa bilbilaan qunnamaatii akka isiniif qoratan gaafadhaa.
am: የስልክ ቁጥርዎን አጻጻፍ በትክክል ያረጋግጡ (ለምሳሌ በ 09... የሚጀምር)።
የይለፍ ቃሉን በትክክል መጻፍዎን ለማረጋገጥ የዓይን ምልክቱን ይጫኑ።
በቅርቡ የቀየሩ ከሆነ አዲሱን የይለፍ ቃል መጠቀሙን ያረጋግጡ።
በአድሚን የተሰጠዎትን ጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ይጠቀሙ።
በጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ሲገቡ ወዲያውኑ አዲስ የራስዎን የይለፍ ቃል እንዲፈጥሩ ይጠይቅዎታል።
አሁንም ካልሰራ የቅርንጫፉን የሰው ኃይል (HR) በማነጋገር ስልክዎ እንዲረጋገጥ እና እንዲታደስ ያድርጉ።

title.en: Troubleshooting: Cannot See My Submitted Payment
title.om: Furmaata: Kaffaltiin Ergame Yoo Mul'achuu Baate
title.am: መፍትሔ: የላኩት ክፍያ በዝርዝር ውስጥ ካልታየ

summary.en: Understand payment verification statuses: PENDING vs VERIFIED vs REJECTED.
summary.om: Haala kaffaltii hubadhaa: Kan Eeggatu (PENDING), Mirkanaa'e (VERIFIED), Kufaa (REJECTED).
summary.am: የክፍያ ሁኔታዎችን ይረዱ: በመጠባበቅ ላይ (PENDING)፣ የተረጋገጠ (VERIFIED)፣ ውድቅ የተደረገ (REJECTED)።

en: Go to 'Kaffaltii Koo' (/dashboard/my-payments) and check your payment list.
Check the yellow 'PENDING' status badge: this means your payment was received and is currently in the collector's verification queue.
Once verified by the collector, the badge turns green 'VERIFIED' and your official stamped receipt becomes printable.
If the badge shows red 'REJECTED', click to view the collector's rejection reason (e.g., blurred slip, incorrect amount, duplicate reference).
If a submitted payment does not appear at all, verify that you pressed 'Kaffaltii Ergi' and received the success message, or submit it again.
om: Gara 'Kaffaltii Koo' (/dashboard/my-payments) deemaatii tarree kaffaltii ilaalaa.
Mallattoo keelloo 'PENDING': kaffaltiin keessan ergamuun walitti-qabaan qorannaa irra jiraachuu agarsiisa.
Yommuu mirkanaa'u gara magariisa 'VERIFIED' jijjiirama, nagaheen chaappaa qabus ni qophaa'a.
Yoo mallattoo diimaa 'REJECTED' agarsiise, sababa walitti-qabaan kuffiseef (fakkii ifa hin taane, lakk. dogoggoraa) ilaalaa.
Garuu kaffaltiin sun gonkumaa hin mul'atu taanaan deebi'aatii sirriitti ergaa.
am: ወደ 'የእኔ ክፍያዎች' (/dashboard/my-payments) በመሄድ የክፍያዎን ዝርዝር ይመልከቱ።
ቢጫ 'PENDING' ምልክት ካለው ክፍያዎ ደርሶ በገንዘብ ሰብሳቢው ማረጋገጫ በመጠባበቅ ላይ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
ሰብሳቢው ሲያረጋግጠው ወደ አረንጓዴ 'VERIFIED' ይቀየራል፣ የማኅተም ያለበት ደረሰኝም ይዘጋጃል።
ቀይ 'REJECTED' ካሳየ ሰብሳቢው ውድቅ ያደረገበትን ምክንያት (ያልጠራ ፎቶ፣ የተሳሳተ ቁጥር) ለማየት ይጫኑ።
የላኩት ክፍያ በጭራሽ ካልታየ በትክክል 'Kaffaltii Ergi' ተጭነው የተሳካ መልዕክት ማየትዎን ያረጋግጡ ወይም በድጋሚ ይላኩ።
